subject: SIG-Lite: access control evidence request & SCIM/SAML artifacts for Sunrise Health
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sunrisehealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: security@sunrisehealth.com
Date: 2026-05-28T15:12:00Z
Subject: Evidence request: SIG-Lite access controls for upcoming vendor review

Hi Olga,

We're kicking off our vendor SIG-Lite for Redwood ahead of an internal procurement review. We need to collect access-control evidence focused on SSO/SCIM/RBAC and least-privilege controls. Specifically, can you provide the following by EOD 2026-06-07: 

- SAML IdP metadata and assertion examples (for audit)
- SCIM attribute mapping and sample provisioning delta logs (last 90 days)
- Export of RBAC role definitions and role-to-permission mapping (current snapshot)
- User and service account inventory with justifications for any admin-level privileges
- Access review cadence and any attestation artifacts

If you prefer, we can accept a redacted bundle and a short walkthrough call next week. I've attached our checklist (Sunrise_SIG_Checklist_20260528.xlsx) for your reference.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Security Engineer, Sunrise Health
security@sunrisehealth.com

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-28T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SIG-Lite access controls for upcoming vendor review

Hi Alex — thanks for the checklist and the heads-up. We can assemble this bundle and aim to deliver an initial package by Tue 2026-06-02, with the full logs and RBAC snapshot by your deadline (2026-06-07).

Quick clarifying items so we align on scope:
- Do you need full SAML assertions (PHI redacted) or just the IdP/SP metadata + example assertion?
- For SCIM deltas, do you want raw audit records or a filtered CSV of provisioning events affecting roles/groups?

I'll coordinate the artifacts from Engineering (Marcus) and Compliance (Neha). We'll prepare a redacted export and share via a secure upload link.

Next steps:
- I will share the RBAC export and SAML metadata by Tue 06/02.
- Marcus: can you include SCIM delta sample + guidance on how we redact usernames?
- Neha: please attach the attestation policy document and recent access-review notes.

If it's helpful, I'm available for a 20-minute walkthrough on Thu 06/03. What time window works for you?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Security Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-29T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SIG-Lite access controls for upcoming vendor review

Olga — tagging in a few technical notes that will go into the bundle. High-level summary below and attachments on our side: rbac_role_snapshot.json (full role -> permission mapping), saml_metadata.xml (IdP metadata + SP endpoints), scim_attribute_map.csv (attribute mapping), access-audit-90d.csv (provisioning events, redacted).

Technical notes:
- SCIM: we store SCIM provisioning events in our audit DB; I exported DELTA events for the last 90 days scoped to group and role changes. We removed email addresses and replaced with consistent pseudonyms (user_###) to preserve privacy.
- RBAC: roles are defined in our config store; the export includes a top-level 'admin' role (few service accounts) and granular 'developer/read' etc. Each role has 'allowed_actions' and 'resource_scope' fields.
- SAML: IdP metadata is signed; assertion samples contain NameID and group claims — we'll provide a single redacted example for audit.
- Service accounts: We have three long-lived service principals with elevated privileges (listed in rbac snapshot). The justification is in the comments column and matches our change-control tickets.

I'll upload the artifacts to the secure bucket and share links. Let me know if Sunrise needs logs in a different format.

— Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Serving Runtime

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-30T08:41:00Z
Subject: Delivery: SIG-Lite access-control bundle (SAML, SCIM, RBAC) — secure links attached

Hi Alex — attaching the initial bundle per your checklist. Files are redacted where appropriate; if you need a signed copy of SAML metadata or raw audit extracts we can provide via a secure transfer.

Included artifacts (attached / secure links):
- saml_metadata.xml (IdP metadata)
- scim_attribute_map.csv (attribute map and mapping notes)
- rbac_role_snapshot.json (current role -> permission mapping)
- access-audit-90d.csv (SCIM provisioning delta events, redacted)
- access-review-policy.pdf (recent attestation schedule and notes)

Secure download: https://uploads.redwood.com/sunrise/secure-package-20260530
Shared drive index: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ_example_shared_drive

A few callouts:
- We redacted identifying user attributes in the audit CSV and replaced them with consistent pseudonyms. We can run a scope-limited export with full identifiers under an NDA if needed.
- The RBAC snapshot includes comments for any role with write/admin privileges.
- Our standard access reviews run quarterly; the attached PDF includes the last two cycles.

Would you like a quick 20-minute walkthrough to review the artifacts and point to where to find the specific fields? I'm free Thu 06/03 between 10:00-13:00 ET.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Security Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sunrisehealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: security@sunrisehealth.com
Date: 2026-05-30T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Delivery: SIG-Lite access-control bundle (SAML, SCIM, RBAC) — secure links attached

Olga — received, thanks. We'll review the bundle and follow up with any clarifying questions. A 20-minute walkthrough on Thu 06/03 at 10:30 ET works for our team. I'll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
Security Engineer, Sunrise Health
